name: hooks
description: Open source hooks library for AI coding agents. FAIL CLOSED (hasna/apps#1720, owner ruling 2026-09-07): every client surface (hooks CLI, hooks-mcp, ./sdk) decides its route before touching any store — a registry credential resolved through the @hasna/contracts 1.0.2 client resolver (strict URL+key pair, fresh per call, src/lib/transport.ts: the Keychain items hasna.credentials.hooks.api-url / .api-key, ~/.hasna/hooks/config/credentials, then HASNA_HOOKS_API_URL / HASNA_HOOKS_API_KEY, fleet gateway https://api.hasna.com/hooks as the URL default) selects the HOSTED route, on which the on-box SQLite store is refused process-wide (src/db/index.ts refuseLocalStore; local-only verbs and tools return REMOTE_COMMAND_UNSUPPORTED and hook events are sent to /api/v1/events and hooks log / hooks_log_* read from the hosted PostgreSQL event store (src/server/event-store.ts); absent server storage returns 503); the on-box store (~/.hasna/hooks/hooks.db, optional PostgreSQL mirror when HASNA_HOOKS_DATABASE_URL + HASNA_HOOKS_STORAGE_BACKEND=postgresql) is reachable ONLY through the explicit opt-in HASNA_HOOKS_LOCAL=1 (alias HOOKS_LOCAL=1), answered from the env before any Keychain/disk read and announced once on stderr; with nothing configured every client surface exits non-zero naming the tiers and the opt-in. The retired HASNA_HOOKS_STORAGE_MODE / HOOKS_STORAGE_MODE variables are read as errors. The app's own chain is gone: ~/.hasna/fleet-env, ~/.hasna/cloud, ~/.config/hasna, $XDG_CONFIG_HOME, ~/.hasna/hooks/config.json (api_url / api_key_ref), HASNA_HOOKS_REGISTRY_URL / HOOKS_REGISTRY_URL, and any *_MODE transport switch are never read. The hosted registry is a Cloudflare Workers API (D1 catalog + R2 artifacts, provisioned by `hooks cf deploy`); hooks-serve serves the local registry on 127.0.0.1 and is server-only.

readiness.description: Implemented: GET /ready returns 200 {status: ready} when the hooks.lock store is readable, else 503 (src/serve.ts).

version.description: Implemented: GET /version returns the installed @hasna/hooks version (src/serve.ts).

pgTestGate.command: HASNA_HOOKS_DATABASE_URL="${HASNA_HOOKS_TEST_DATABASE_URL:?point it at a throwaway Postgres; the live-PG gate must not pass without one}" HASNA_HOOKS_STORAGE_BACKEND=postgresql bun test src/db/pg-live.test.ts
